q: Which country's flag has a single red maple leaf on a white square between two red bars?
x: Red and white have been Canada's official colors since 1921, and the leaf design has flown since 1965.

q: A red disc on a plain white field is the national flag of which Asian country?
x: Japan is called the Land of the Rising Sun, and the red disc stands for the sun.

q: How many stars appear on the flag of the United States?
x: There is one star for each state; the 50th was added in 1960 after Hawaii joined the Union.

q: How many stripes does the flag of the United States have?
x: The seven red and six white stripes stand for the original thirteen colonies.

q: Which country has the only national flag that is not a rectangle or square?
x: Nepal's flag is made of two stacked triangular pennants, topped with a moon and a sun.

q: A green cedar tree on a white band between two red bands appears on the flag of which country?
x: The cedar is a national symbol of the country and is mentioned many times in ancient texts.

q: Which Himalayan kingdom's flag shows a white dragon across a yellow and orange field?
x: The dragon is called Druk, which is also the local name of the country, 'Land of the Thunder Dragon.'

q: Which country's flag is square, showing a white cross on a red background?
x: Switzerland and Vatican City are the only two sovereign states with square national flags.

q: The Dannebrog, a white cross on a red field, is often called the oldest continuously used national flag of which country?
x: Its name means 'Danish cloth,' and it inspired the other Nordic cross flags.

q: Which country's green flag has a yellow diamond with a blue globe in the middle?
x: The globe carries the motto 'Ordem e Progresso,' meaning 'Order and Progress.'

q: An eagle perched on a cactus and holding a snake appears on the flag of which country?
x: The emblem recalls the Aztec legend of an eagle on a cactus marking the site of their capital.

q: Which country has a vertical tricolor of green, white and red with no emblem?
x: Its design was inspired by the French tricolor in the late 1700s.

q: Which country's flag is made of three horizontal bands of black, red and gold?
x: These colors are linked to the 1848 liberal movement for German unity.

q: Which country's flag has vertical bands of blue, white and red, with blue next to the flagpole?
x: Blue and red are the colors of Paris, and white was the color of the royal house; they were joined in 1789.

q: Which country's flag has vertical stripes of green, white and orange, with green at the hoist?
x: The white band stands for peace between the green and orange traditions on the island.

q: Which country's flag has red and yellow horizontal bands, with the yellow band twice as wide as each red one?
x: A coat of arms with the Pillars of Hercules sits on the yellow stripe near the hoist.

q: The Union Jack combines the crosses of St George, St Andrew and which other saint?
x: St Patrick's red diagonal cross was added in 1801 to represent Ireland.

q: How many horizontal stripes does the flag of Greece have?
x: Blue and white stripes alternate, with a white cross in the blue canton. A popular tale links the nine stripes to the syllables of 'Freedom or Death.'

q: Which country's flag is white with two blue horizontal stripes and a blue six-pointed star?
x: The stripes echo a Jewish prayer shawl, the tallit.

q: Which country's flag has saffron, white and green bands with a navy blue wheel in the middle?
x: The wheel is the Ashoka Chakra, taken from an ancient pillar of the emperor Ashoka.

q: Which country's red flag has one large yellow star and four smaller ones in the upper left corner?
x: Adopted in 1949, it is nicknamed the Five-star Red Flag.

q: Which Southeast Asian country's flag is red with one large yellow five-pointed star?
x: In Vietnamese the flag is called 'co do sao vang,' the red flag with a yellow star.

q: Which Caribbean country's flag has five blue and white stripes and a red triangle holding a white star?
x: The single star earned it the nickname 'La Estrella Solitaria,' the Lone Star.

q: Which country's flag is a gold diagonal cross dividing it into green and black triangles?
x: Jamaica's is the only national flag that uses none of red, white or blue.

q: Which country's green flag shows white Arabic script above a sword?
x: The script is the Shahada, the Islamic declaration of faith.

q: Which country's red, white and black tricolor has a golden eagle in the center?
x: The emblem is called the Eagle of Saladin, after the medieval sultan.

q: Which country's flag has a sideways Y-shaped band that merges into a single horizontal stripe?
x: Adopted in 1994, the Y is often read as diverse groups coming together.

q: Which African country has an assault rifle on its flag?
x: The rifle sits on a red star alongside a hoe and an open book.

q: Which Caribbean island's flag shows a purple parrot inside a red disc?
x: The bird is the Sisserou parrot, which is found only on this island.

q: Which island nation's flag has a golden lion holding a sword on a maroon panel?
x: Four bo leaves fill the corners of the maroon panel.

q: Which Mediterranean island's flag shows a copper-colored map of the island above two olive branches?
x: The copper color alludes to the island's ancient copper mining, and the branches stand for peace.

q: Which country's flag has a Union Jack in the corner and four red stars with white borders on blue?
x: The four stars form the Southern Cross constellation.

q: Which Nordic country's flag is a yellow cross on a blue field?
x: Blue and gold come from the national coat of arms, which shows three gold crowns on blue.

q: Which country's white flag with a blue cross is meant to recall its lakes and snow?
x: Finland is known as the land of a thousand lakes.

q: Which Nordic country's red flag has a blue cross outlined in white?
x: The cross is off-center, with the vertical bar closer to the hoist, a typical Nordic cross layout.

q: Which island nation's blue flag has a red cross edged in white?
x: A common explanation is red for volcanic fire, white for ice and blue for the mountains.

q: Which country's tricolor runs white, blue, red from top to bottom?
x: Horizontal white, blue and red bands have flown over the country in various forms for centuries.

q: Which country's flag has just two horizontal bands, white above red?
x: The colors come from the white eagle on a red shield in the Polish coat of arms.

q: Which country's flag is made of two horizontal bands, blue above yellow?
x: The colors are commonly said to show a blue sky over golden wheat fields.

q: Which country's flag has three equal horizontal bands of red, white and red?
x: According to legend, a duke's white tunic was stained red with blood except under his belt.

q: Which country's flag has vertical bands of black, yellow and red?
x: The colors come from the arms of the Duchy of Brabant, a black lion on gold.

q: Which country's flag is split into green and red, with a yellow armillary sphere on the border?
x: The armillary sphere is a navigation instrument that recalls the Age of Discovery.

q: Which South American country's flag has a white star on a blue square in the top left, plus white and red stripes?
x: Blue is said to stand for the sky, white for the snowy Andes and red for blood shed for independence.

q: Which country's flag has a yellow band twice as tall as the blue and red bands below, with no emblem?
x: A popular reading is yellow for gold, blue for the seas and red for blood shed for independence.

q: Which African country's flag has three vertical bands in green, white and green?
x: Green stands for agriculture and white for peace.

q: Which African country's red, gold and green flag has a black star in the center?
x: The black star symbolizes African freedom, and the national football team is nicknamed the Black Stars.

q: Which country's green flag has a white vertical stripe at the hoist and a white crescent and star?
x: The white stripe is for religious minorities, and the green field for the Muslim majority.

q: Which country's flag is dark green with a red disc placed slightly off-center?
x: The disc is shifted toward the hoist so that it looks centered when the flag is flying.

q: Which country's flag has five horizontal stripes of red, white, blue, white and red, with the blue band twice as wide?
x: The central blue stripe is associated with the monarchy.

q: Which country's flag has a white crescent beside five white stars above a white band, with a red band on top?
x: Red is for brotherhood and white for purity.

q: How many red and white stripes does the flag of Malaysia have?
x: The stripes match the 13 states plus the federal territory, and the star in the canton has 14 points.

q: A white crescent and five-pointed star on a plain red field form the flag of which country?
x: Moon-and-star symbols were used long before the modern republic, in the Ottoman era.

q: Which Southeast Asian country's flag has a white triangle holding a sun and three stars?
x: The sun's eight rays honor the first eight provinces that rose against Spain.

q: Which UK nation's flag shows a red dragon on a green and white background?
x: The Welsh dragon is not represented in the Union Jack, which uses only English, Scottish and Irish crosses.

q: Which UK nation's flag is a white diagonal cross on a blue field?
x: It shows the saltire, the X-shaped cross on which St Andrew was said to have been crucified.

q: The flag of the United Nations shows a world map framed by which plant?
x: Olive branches are a classic symbol of peace; the white emblem sits on a light blue field.

q: In flag terms, what name is given to a flag with three bands of different colors?
x: The French Tricolore made the design famous, but many countries use three-band flags.

q: What does waving a plain white flag traditionally signal?
x: Under international law, a white flag signals a wish to negotiate or surrender.

q: In motor racing, what does the black-and-white checkered flag signal?
x: The first driver to cross the line under the checkered flag wins the race.

q: Which Balkan country's red flag has a black double-headed eagle?
x: Its local name, Shqiperia, is often translated as 'land of the eagles.'

q: Which Mediterranean country's flag has a small George Cross in the upper left corner?
x: The George Cross was awarded to the island for its bravery in World War II.

q: Which Pacific country's flag has a bird of paradise and the Southern Cross on a red and black field?
x: The bird is a raggiana bird-of-paradise, and the field is divided diagonally.

q: A broken trident appears on the flag of which Caribbean island?
x: The blue bands stand for the ocean and sky, and the gold band for the sand.

q: Which South American country's flag has light blue and white stripes and a golden sun with a face at the center?
x: The sun is the Sun of May, recalling the 1810 May Revolution.

q: Which country's blue flag has a Union Jack in the corner and a large seven-pointed star below it?
x: The big star is the Commonwealth Star, with one point for the states and one for the territories.

q: The flag of which country has a red and blue circle surrounded by four black trigrams?
x: The circle, the taegeuk, balances yin and yang, while the trigrams stand for heaven, earth, fire and water.

q: Which country's flag was inaugurated in February 1965 after a long parliamentary debate?
x: It replaced the Red Ensign, which had carried a Union Jack in the corner.

q: Which country's flag is nicknamed the Union Jack?
x: The flag is officially called the Union Flag, though 'Union Jack' is the popular name.

q: Which country's flag has horizontal red, white and green bands from top to bottom, with no emblem?
x: Red, white and green also appear in the colors of the national coat of arms.

q: Which Baltic country's flag has horizontal bands of blue, black and white from top to bottom?
x: Blue is often linked to sky and lakes, black to the soil and white to striving for light.

q: Which Baltic country's flag has yellow, green and red horizontal bands?
x: Yellow is explained as the sun and fields, green as forests and red as blood shed for the nation.

q: Which country's flag has horizontal bands of white, green and red from top to bottom?
x: It follows the Pan-Slavic pattern but swaps blue for green.

q: Which North African country's red flag has a green five-pointed star made of interlaced lines?
x: The green star is known as the Seal of Solomon.

q: Which East African country's flag features a Maasai shield and two crossed spears?
x: Black stands for the people, red for the blood shed in the struggle and green for the land.

q: A stone bird sits on a red star in the flag of which southern African country?
x: The bird is based on soapstone carvings found at the ruins of Great Zimbabwe.

q: Which country's flag has a black triangle at the hoist beside bands of aquamarine, gold and aquamarine?
x: Aquamarine stands for the sea and gold for the sunny sand.

q: Which twin-island country's flag has a black diagonal band edged in white on a red field?
x: The black band runs from the upper hoist corner down to the lower fly corner.

q: Which Pacific country's light blue flag has a Union Jack and a shield with a lion?
x: The shield also shows sugar cane, a coconut palm and a dove of peace.

q: Which Southeast Asian country's flag has a white disc on a wide blue band between two red bands?
x: A common explanation is that the white disc is the moon over the Mekong River.

q: Which tiny state's square flag is half yellow, half white, with crossed keys on the white half?
x: Yellow and white are the papal colors, and the keys are those of St Peter.

q: How many gold stars form the circle on the flag of the European Union?
x: The number is fixed at twelve as a symbol of unity and does not change with the number of members.

q: Which Asian country's flag shows a famous temple, Angkor Wat?
x: It is one of the very few national flags to show a building.

q: Which South American country's flag has red, white and red vertical bands?
x: Besides the plain civil flag, the state flag carries a coat of arms with a vicuna and a cinchona tree.

q: What does it usually mean when a flag is flown at half-mast?
x: Lowering the flag partway is a sign of mourning for a death or tragedy.

q: What emblem is on the pirate flag known as the Jolly Roger?
x: Pirate captains often had their own variants, some adding an hourglass.

q: What color is the background of the Olympic flag?
x: The five colored rings stand out on a plain white field.

q: Which country's flag is known as Old Glory?
x: The nickname is said to date back to the 1820s, long before the flag reached 50 stars.

q: Which country's flag is a red cross on a white field, known as St George's Cross?
x: St George's Cross forms the red part at the center of the Union Jack.

q: Which mythical creature appears on the flags of both Bhutan and Wales?
x: Bhutan's white dragon and Wales' red dragon are two of the most famous flag creatures.

q: Which bird of prey appears on the flags of Mexico, Egypt and Albania?
x: Eagles are among the most common animals on national flags.

q: The red disc on Japan's flag represents which heavenly body?
x: Japan's name in Japanese means 'origin of the sun.'

q: Which country's flag has white and red bands with a blue triangle at the hoist?
x: The blue wedge was added when Czechoslovakia created its flag in 1920.

q: Which country's flag has green, white and red bands and a red emblem in the center spelling out the word Allah?
x: The phrase 'Allahu Akbar' is repeated along the borders of the green and red bands.

q: Which Central American country's flag has four quarters, with a blue star and a red star on white?
x: The top-left quarter has a blue star and the bottom-right quarter a red star.

q: Which country's red, white and blue flag has a red-and-white checkerboard shield in the middle?
x: The checkerboard, called the sahovnica, is a very old symbol of the country.

q: Which Mediterranean country's flag has a white cross in a blue canton and blue and white stripes?
x: Its colors are said to evoke the blue sea and the white of the waves and clouds.

q: Which country's vertical green, white and red flag has an eagle emblem in the center band?
x: The eagle emblem is the only thing separating it from Italy's flag at a glance.

q: Which Nordic country's flag is a white cross on a red field, with the cross reaching all four edges?
x: The Dannebrog is the model for every other Nordic cross flag.

q: Which South American country's flag has an arc of white stars on its blue band?
x: The stars sit in the middle band of yellow, blue and red.

q: Which country's flag is a red circle on a plain white background?
x: Japan's flag is called Nisshoki, or Hinomaru, meaning circle of the sun.
